botcomponent.description: Run the demo using the two bundled independent coffee studies. Launch two normalizer instances in parallel, wait for BOTH outputs to be ready, then launch multiple claim-specific fact-checker instances in parallel against scientific web sources. Request a different available model family for at least one checker. Only after all checks return, generate the comparative research brief. Report actual artifacts and limitations, never simulated execution.
